req.title: Cookie name path segment escaping
req.statement: The system shall percent-decode the <name> and <value> path segments in /cookies/set/<name>/<value>.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that /cookies/set/<name>/<value> must percent-decode the name and value path segments. Flask/Werkzeug automatically percent-decodes path segments before passing them to the route handler, so the handler receives the decoded strings. Tests must verify: (1) a normal cookie name/value is set correctly (EP positive), (2) a percent-encoded name is decoded and set as the decoded string (EP positive with encoding), (3) a percent-encoded value is decoded correctly (BVA), (4) special characters like spaces encoded as %20 are decoded (BVA boundary), (5) an empty or minimal name/value (BVA boundary), and (6) a path with no encoding passes through unchanged (NEG/DT). The test client follows redirects to verify the cookie appears in /cookies response. We assert exact status codes (302 for redirect, 200 after follow), exact cookie names and values in the JSON payload, and both sides of the encoding boundary.

tests.name: test_plain_cookie_name_value_set_correctly
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: No other unexpected cookies in response
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: plain name/value path segments are passed through unchanged
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_plain_cookie_name_value_set_correctly():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/mycookie/myvalue', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies']['mycookie'] == 'myvalue'

test_plain_cookie_name_value_set_correctly()

tests.name: test_percent_encoded_name_is_decoded
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Verify the cookie name is decoded to 'my cookie'
expected: The raw encoded name 'my%20cookie' does NOT appear as a key
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: percent-encoded <name> segment must be decoded before setting cookie
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_percent_encoded_name_is_decoded():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/my%20cookie/hello', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert 'my cookie' in data['cookies']
    assert data['cookies']['my cookie'] == 'hello'
    assert 'my%20cookie' not in data['cookies']

test_percent_encoded_name_is_decoded()

from httpbin.core import app

def test_percent_encoded_value_is_decoded():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/token/hello%20world', follow_redirects=True)

tests.name: test_percent_encoded_special_chars_in_name_and_value
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Verify name decoded to 'foo!' and value decoded to 'bar@baz'
expected: Encoded forms do not appear as keys or values
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: both name and value percent-decoded simultaneously
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_percent_encoded_special_chars_in_name_and_value():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/foo%21/bar%40baz', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert 'foo!' in data['cookies']
    assert data['cookies']['foo!'] == 'bar@baz'
    assert 'foo%21' not in data['cookies']

test_percent_encoded_special_chars_in_name_and_value()

tests.name: test_redirect_response_before_following
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Verify initial response is 302 redirect to /cookies
expected: HTTP 302 status code on initial response
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: set_cookie handler redirects to view_cookies after setting cookie
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_response_before_following():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/x/y', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert '/cookies' in location
    assert '/cookies/set' not in location

test_redirect_response_before_following()

preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Verify single-character name 'a' and value 'b' are set exactly
expected: Exactly the single-char name and value, no truncation or expansion
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: minimal (single-char) name and value boundary case
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_single_char_name_and_value_boundary():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/a/b', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert 'a' in data['cookies']
    assert data['cookies']['a'] == 'b'
    assert data['cookies']['a'] != 'bb'
    assert data['cookies']['a'] != ''

test_single_char_name_and_value_boundary()

tests.name: test_missing_value_segment_returns_404
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: endpoint requires both <name> and <value>; missing value is a client error
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_missing_value_segment_returns_404():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/onlyname', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 404
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 302
    assert r.status_code != 500

from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_encoded_hyphen_and_underscore_in_name():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/my%2Dcookie/val%5Fone', follow_redirects=True)
